    12 |   token   : string  secret
  = The mark is `secret` at loop_rounds.flow:12.
  = Temporal, Step Functions, Lambda durable functions and Argo Workflows keep the inputs and outputs of the workflow and of every call in the history, which whoever may read the executions can read.
  = Start the workflow with a reference instead (an ID, the name of a secret), and fetch the value inside the task that uses it. If the history is encrypted with a key you hold (Temporal: a payload codec; Step Functions and Lambda durable functions: a customer managed KMS key), write `history encrypted` under `workflow`.

warning[W107]: tests/fixtures/loop_rounds.flow:97:1: this loop passes values on past the rounds the checks follow (64): they read `c00`, `c01`, `c02`, `c03`, `c04`, `c05` and `c06` as every value put in them anywhere in the flow
    97 |   repeat at most 3 times
  = A round passes a value on by one `let`: a value passed back one variable a round takes as many rounds as the variables it goes through.
  = What the checks say of these variables in the loop and after it (a secret, a value of an enum, a range) may come from a value no run brings there.
  = Put the value in each variable from where it comes from, rather than from the variable before it a round at a time.
